purpose: Separate actual LoRA control, not part of 8-model Ollama ranking; fixed settings without test tuning
training_selection: one random judged 0 and one judged 1 per train query; seed42; at most 128 pairs
probability: softmax of next-token logits restricted to tokens 0 and 1, no verbalized confidence
calibration: raw uncalibrated conditional binary token probability; ECE/Brier descriptive
